summaries.text:
American Family Fair Minimum Wage Act of 1995 - Amends the Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938 to increase the Federal minimum wage from $4.25 per hour to: (1) $4.75 beginning on September 1, 1995; (2) $5.25 beginning on September 1, 1996; and (3) $5.75 during the year beginning on September 1, 1997.

Establishes the Commission on the Minimum Wage to study and report to the appropriate congressional committees on the indexation of the Federal minimum wage.
